title: aster calendulaceus
intro: Aster calendulaceus, commonly known as the Flame Aster, is a perennial plant species native to the eastern United States and Canada. It belongs to the Asteraceae family and is known for its vibrant orange or yellow flowers that bloom in mid to late summer. The health benefits of Aster calendulaceus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function, thanks to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
